mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates signal accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers central bank tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise >1.0% MoM (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession labor market recovery regimes with declining unemployment and rising employment, enhanced consumer spending supports corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative/flat in >50% of post-recession labor market recovery periods (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls >0.5% MoM (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1.3 million units per month indicate strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of months when HOUST > 1300.0 (Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles with federal funds rates above 2.5%, reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs suppress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth and unemployment decline signal a strengthening labor market, enhancing consumer spending and corporate profitability to drive positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS rises >100k and UNRATE falls >0.2pp (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year window.
